subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: When cron or a manual invocation selects a job, the executor shall use that job's validated published policy from the configured remote branch without mutating the enrolled checkout's Git storage.
fit_criterion: Published prompt/disable/routing updates apply; unmerged policy supplies zero instructions; fetch and coordination fixtures preserve enrolled refs, FETCH_HEAD, index, source/untracked work, and configuration; only prescribed ignored diagnostics may be appended/exported there
